title: Mouse Browser 6.0.28 native evidence bundle
$comment: The publisher validates the source workflow's archived evidence and a fresh installed DMG run. The independent mouse628-evidence.py and mouse628-motion-trace.py validators recompute pixel and motion acceptance from the exact archived inputs. A saved report alone is not an acceptance input. A synthetic native swipe fixture verifies first-use lifecycle; a physical trackpad gesture is not claimed.
